title: Procedure
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
The contract account category allows you to assign multiple business partners to a contract account. You have already assigned a
business partner to the contract account.

Procedure

1. On the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |}#Master Data » Contract Account » Change %(CAA2) and enter the required
contract account.

2. The first screen for data entry appears.

3. Choose |)Goto » New Partner | to jump to a dialog box in which you can assign an additional business partner to the
account.

After you execute the function, all fields that contain business partner-specific data appear initial (or with their default values) and
the general data remains unchanged.

Displaying or Editing Other Business Partners

Prerequisites

Several business partners must be assigned to the contract account.

Procedure

You can use the OtherPartner function to switch between the data of individual partners in the contract account.

1. On the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |}#Master Data» Contract Account > Display 3 (CAA3).
Enter the required contract account.
2. Then choose |+Goto . Other » Partner

3. The system displays a selection window for the business partners already assigned to the contract account.

4. Choose a business partner.

The data for this business partner is displayed and can be processed.

Selecting Addresses for Business Partners

Prerequisites

You have defined multiple addresses for a business partner want to use each of these addresses for a specific purpose (for
